examples.text:
White can capture an unprotected piece with both 1.Rxb3 and 1.exd5.

However, 1.exd5 (red arrow) allows a pin on the rook: 1…Ba5!. White loses material.

1.Rxb3, on the other hand, wins material. White captures the knight and also removes the rook from the diagonal of the black bishop. Black's trick is thus prevented.

texts: Choose the right capture. Always ask yourself: what can the opponent do in response?
